name: Okuma GENOS L200E-M
description: Slant-bed CNC lathe with a 12-station turret with driven (M) tools and a C axis on the main spindle, OSP-P200L-R control. Diameter-programmed X. The 2D preview draws the X-Z turning path; C-axis / live-tool milling is listed but not drawn.
sources: Okuma GENOS L200E-M published specification: X 165 mm / Z 400 mm travels, max turning diameter 200 mm and length 380 mm, 4500 rpm main spindle (bar capacity 50 mm), 6000 rpm M-tool spindle, 12-station turret, rapids 20 (X) / 25 (Z) m/min
Okuma OSP-P200L Programming Manual (lathe): G/M code tables, LAP cycles, compound fixed cycles, User Task 2

kinematics.description: Z carriage along the spindle axis, X cross-slide (radial), turret on the cross-slide; the C axis turns the chuck and workpiece. Preview coordinates are X radius and Z along the spindle.
